dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs cmdSubcategory; .ledger/subcategories.json. FeatureSet#sections is the single layout both renderers walk. `ledger status` mentions a sub-section that leads with a Big entry, since its heading and intro already are that part's overview.

history.name: Sub-sections inside an area
history.description: A sub-section is a heading between an area and its features, for an area with a real part inside it, with a name and a short overview. You file a feature into it when you record or change it. A sub-section that arrives whole in one release is flagged once, not with a column of New marks.
